prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity desktop web application screen for 案卷, a Chinese AI product investigation and evidence reading tool. Render edge to edge at desktop landscape with crisp Chinese text, no browser frame. This is a layout proposal, clearly label 设计预览 · 非调查结果. The user's job is reading an investigation answer then tracing its citations to original sources. Question: 这款 AI 产品的能力与限制，有哪些可靠依据？ Lead with a continuous white research reading sheet and an evidence marginal index, rather than a grid of identical cards. Reading order: compact question header, a restrained amber 需要身份确认 state with action 确认身份, then 调查回答, 主张核查, 引用与来源原文. Answer sample explicitly says 等待调查完成后，这里展示回答与引用, never invent findings or statistics. Left lightweight 224px navigation with 案卷 and 发起调查. On the right edge of the white reading sheet a quiet vertical section index with 01 调查回答, 02 主张核查, 03 引用与来源, 04 冲突和证据缺口, 05 快照信息. Pale blue #F3F7FC workspace, white sheet, dark navy #17233B type, restrained #326BDA interactive blue. Modern Chinese sans serif typography, fine cool borders, precise generous rhythm, professional legible compact metadata. One dominant reading plane, no charts, no photos, no gradients, no glow. Fully designed application screen.
